QuestInfo.name: [Gollux] The Cleansing
QuestInfo.0: There must be a way to cleanse Gollux of its corruption. Go speak to the guardian that showed you the pathway.
QuestInfo.1: Attack the vital point you were told about to bring down Gollux.
QuestInfo.2: Gollux has been purified. But the memory of its corruption remains, and it cannot revert to its original form as the Heart Tree.
